training_scope: other two primary-labeled tasks from the same repository
notes: For each held-out task, set the weighted score threshold to the minimum primary target score among the other tasks in that repository.
Held-out primary labels are excluded from threshold calibration and used only for evaluation.
No candidate-count cap, top-k selection, model call, or directory model decision is used.
Each repository has only three diagnostic tasks; this leave-one-out check does not replace a fresh holdout suite.
